title: Tandem affinity purification of a bait host protein in presence of a viral protein
author: Benoit Besson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jeqcjdw
materials: 50 mL IP buffer (1 week, 4°C) 45 mL of H 2 O 3mL from NaCl 5M stock (300 mM) 1,5 mL from Tris-HCl pH 7,4, 1M stock (30 mM) 0,5 g of Triton (1 %) 1 mM EDTA (supplemented with the tablet of protease inhibitor) * Add 1 tablet of protease inhibitor Complete (Roche) / 50 mL lysis buffer. * Add 1 tablet PhosStop (Roche) / 10 mL lysis buffer.

100 mL TBS 92 mL of H2O 5 mL from Tris-HCl, pH 7.4, 1M stock (50 mM) 3 mL from NaCl 5M stock (150 mM) TBS-ETDA 50 / 10 mL TBS 20 / 4 µL from EDTA 0,5 M (0,2 mM) 10 mL TBS-inhibitors TBS * Add 1 tablet of protease inhibitor Complete EDTA-free (Roche) / 10 mL TBS. * Add 1 tablet PhosStop (Roche) / 10 mL TBS. Prepare 3X Flag peptide Dissolve 3X flag peptide (F 4799; Sigma-Aldrich) in TBS-inhibitors at concentration 5 mg/mL. Aliquot and store at -20 o C. Repeated freezing and thawing is not recommended.

steps.title: Seed HeLa Cells
steps.instruction: Plate 5 x 10^6 (± 1/6.5 of a confluent T150) HeLa cells in 20 mL of DMEM 10% FBS on 75cm flasks (10 flasks per condition).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Lipofectamine 2000 and DNA mixtures.

substeps.instruction: Mix 60 µL of Lipofectamine 2000 with 940 µL of DMEM.
Mix 10 µg of DNA (3.34 µg V5-tagged viral protein + 6.66 µg FLAG-GFP tagged bait) in 1 mL of DMEM (final volume).
Add the DNA mix to the Lipofectamine mix and incubate for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfect HeLa Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect the cells by replacing a portion of the medium with the transfection mix.

substeps.instruction: Remove 5 mL of DMEM from the flask.
Add 2 mL of the transfection mix (final volume of 17 mL).
Incubate for 24 hours at 37°C, 5% CO2.

steps.title: Harvest Cells and Prepare Lysate
steps.instruction: Collect cells and prepare the protein extract.

substeps.instruction: Remove culture medium and wash 2X with 1X PBS.
Add 2 mL of PBS per flask and scrape cells with a cell scraper.
Collect all cells in one 50 mL tube and spin at 3000 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and add 5 mL of IP buffer.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C under gentle rotation.
Transfer to 2 mL tubes and spin at 13,000 g for 30 min at 4°C.
Transfer supernatants to a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration using a BCA kit according to the provider's instructions.

steps.title: Pre-clear Protein with A/G Beads
steps.instruction: Incubate 30 mg of protein with 200 µL agarose A/G beads (50% beads) in a 15 mL tube for 1 hour at 4°C under gentle rotation.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 2500 g for 5 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Perform First Affinity Purification (Anti-FLAG)
steps.instruction: Purify the bait complex using ANTI-FLAG M2 beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash 200 µL ANTI-FLAG M2 beads (A2220; Sigma-Aldrich) with 1 mL IP buffer in 1.5 mL tubes by spinning 1 min at 5000 g at 4°C; repeat 2X.
Transfer the supernatant from the pre-clearing step to 200 µL ANTI-FLAG M2 beads in a 15 mL tube.
Incubate overnight at 4°C under gentle rotation.
Spin at 5000 g for 1 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Wash 3X with 1000 µL IP buffer (spin 1 min at 5000 g, 4°C).

steps.title: Elute from Anti-FLAG Beads
steps.instruction: Elute the bound proteins using 3X FLAG elution solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 3X FLAG elution solution (1 mg/mL, diluted with 10 mL TBS-inhibitors) to each sample.
Rotate for 1 hour at 4°C.

steps.title: Perform Second Affinity Purification (GFP TRAP)
steps.instruction: Purify the complex further using GFP TRAP beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash 100 µL GFP TRAP beads with 1 mL TBS-EDTA by spinning 5 min at 2500 g at 4°C; repeat 3X.
Centrifuge resin for 5 min at 2500 g at 4°C and transfer supernatant to fresh tubes.
Repeat the elution steps (from step 8 to 11) 3X to collect fractions E1, E2, and E3.
Transfer E1-3 with 100 µL GFP TRAP_A beads (ChromoTek) and top up to 1 mL with TBS-EDTA.
Rotate for 1 hour at 4°C.
Centrifuge resin for 2 min at 2500 g at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Wash 3X with 1000 µL TBS-EDTA.

steps.title: Final Protein Recovery and Analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the final protein elution for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Re-suspend beads in 100 µL 2X LDS (NUPAGE, 4X) and 1X Reducing agent (NUPAGE, 10X).
Heat at 95°C for 10 min.
Spin at 12,500 g for 2 min.
Freeze protein elution at -20°C.
Use 20 µL for western blot and 2 x 40 µL for keratin-free SDS-PAGE before proceeding to mass spectrometry.
